'''Lem Trudo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who worked for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], he informed a Republic allied individual about an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] plot to poison a well in one of the Sand People's encampments. He then sent the individual to prevent this by administering an antidote.<ref name="TOR" />
